marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet Giants & Southbound Capital Inflows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.8% as Southbound net inflows exceeded HKD 5.2 billion, concentrated largely in Tencent and Meituan following positive domestic consumption updates.
marketLayer.inference: Mainland institutional investors continue to leverage low valuation windows in HK-listed tech giants, providing liquidity support against broader macroeconomic softness.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustainability of domestic consumer recovery and potential shifts in global risk appetite.

marketLayer.title: US Big Tech AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: US tech megacaps signaled continued upward revisions for 2026 capital expenditures on cloud and AI hardware, alongside mixed near-term margin guidance.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained demand for semiconductor and AI hardware suppliers, though software and cloud platforms face heightened investor scrutiny over ROI timelines.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of enterprise AI monetization and potential supply chain bottlenecks in advanced chip packaging.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Expectations & Global FX Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: Recent US labor market cooling data reinforced market pricing for a September Fed rate cut, pulling the US Dollar Index down below key technical support levels.
marketLayer.inference: Easing yield pressure benefits Hong Kong dollar-denominated assets and liquidity-sensitive high-dividend yield sectors like HK utilities and telecom.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Upcoming core PCE inflation readouts potentially challenging the dovish monetary policy trajectory.

marketLayer.title: China EV & New Energy Price Competition
marketLayer.fact: Leading mainland EV manufacturers announced renewed promotional subsidies and export acceleration strategies targeting Southeast Asian and European markets.
marketLayer.inference: Domestic gross margins remain under pressure, pushing OEMs to aggressive overseas expansion to maintain margin durability.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving foreign anti-dumping investigations and international tariff policies.
